speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief, brethren. The glass is turned. This is the last Sunday of flesh, and Ash Wednesday is Wednesday. Three days.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Three days, Master Thwaite. I can count three days without a glass. The loaf this morning was a penny, and a finger short of the notch. Mark me. I am carrying the heel so the notch can see it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Which hunger is mine, mistress? The church's, or the loaf's? I can feel the one. I have not met the other.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will meet the salt on Wednesday, Alse, and you will not like the introduction. Today the house still eats flesh. Tonight I am at the Bull, and I am home after.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The glass is turned a second time. Forty days are not three days. A man who counts only the near end will be surprised by the far one. I have turned it so you may see both ends, briefly.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I will not salt the house ahead of the church. Sunday is beef if the beef is in the house. Wednesday is fish if the fish can be had. I do not begin the fast in the larder to look holy on a Monday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody has asked you to. Master Thwaite has asked us to be brief, and he has turned the glass twice to prove it. The heel of the loaf is doing more work than a third turning of that glass.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I am brief in the intention. The text is not brief. The commination is Wednesday, and I shall read it as it is written, curses in their places. I am not reading it in this porch to save myself the labour.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Are the curses for us, sir, or for the people who stayed in bed?

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: They are for the parish. A parish includes the beds. You may tell the beds so, if they will hear a maid sooner than a curate. I have no hope of the beds. I have a little hope of the porch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She will tell the cat. The cat is on the Ovid and has been since yesterday, and the cat does not come to church. I swept this porch. The close brought the mud back. I call both of those positions.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave Gib on the book. He is the only scholar in the house who does not explain himself at supper. I am not taking him to the Bull, and I am not taking the Ovid either.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Supper. Yes. The last of the flesh. I do not dine at the Bull. I say it so you will not look for me there, and so the beef may be hearty without my assistance.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not look for you. The company looks for itself. If there is a song, Augustine may start it. I would rather he started it at the Bull than against this glass.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will be in by nine. I am not asking. I am telling the stair what to expect. Callers stop at the foot of it, and a man full of beef is still a caller if he forgets the hour. Wipe the porch off your heel before you bring it up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Close on nine. I have said it. If I am later, the purse will have failed before the clock did. I will wipe the heel. I am not taking the shoes off in your porch to prove it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I lay a trencher, sir, or will the Bull have finished you?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Bull will finish the beef. You may leave the board. Bread in the morning is enough, and the loaf is already a finger short, so do not shorten it again out of kindness.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief. I have said so. The second glass is out. Go home, eat what the day still allows, and do not come to me on Tuesday with a pancake in your pocket and a question about the fast.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Tuesday is Shrove. I will have pancakes if the eggs hold. I will not have them on Wednesday to console anybody. Master Shakespeare, your shoes are still in the mud. I can see them from here, which is a convenience.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are on my feet, Mistress, which is where shoes do their work. Three days. I have the three days. I have the loaf. I have the Bull. I have not asked you for a sermon, and you have not given me one. I count that as peace.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sir John is three rows ahead. He has not turned. I am not going up the aisle to make him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixpence, Mistress, for the firing and the washing. It runs till Lady Day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have the sixpence. It does not salt the house, and it does not buy a second sermon.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Peace is a large word for a short loaf, sir.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And a true one. God keep the house till Wednesday. I will not keep it. I have Wednesday's reading to look over, and I already like it more than a Christian should admit in a porch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done being brief. Tell Gib, if he asks, that the Ovid is still his until I want the desk. I do not want the desk tonight.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The desk can wait, and so can the cat. The mud will not. I am going home to the beef, and I am taking the heel with me, so the notch is not argued twice.
